label: preparing
what: A coordinated jubilee celebration or feast in the great hall, with two hundred loaves commissioned and financed by freight, baked and delivered with the baker, and directed into table chests by the innkeeper. The eighteen-hundred lighting inspection appears to be a pretext for bringing me into the prepared hall. Builder and secretary are helping arrange the lighting and appointment, although their knowledge of the concealed celebration is less certain. The exact occasion and any other participants remain unconfirmed.
